title: MeterTap - audio-thread Pearson correlation one-pole, lock-free AbstractFifo pair push, atomic rho
description:
Implement Source/DSP/MeterTap only. Wave-1 standalone metering block used by ShredWidthEngine / processBlock for UI transport.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§9.3 (Pearson ρ), 9.4 (Audio→UI transport), 7 (RT-safety: no lock/alloc/String on push)
- Existing JUCE AbstractFifo usage patterns in sibling plugins if present under /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/

Implement class MeterTap in Source/DSP/MeterTap.h + MeterTap.cpp:
1. API: prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlock), reset(), pushSample(float L, float R) and/or pushBlock(const float* L, const float* R, int n), float getCorrelation() const (or load atomic), and a drain API for the UI thread (e.g. popPairs into caller buffers via AbstractFifo read).
2. Correlation: normalized Pearson on output L/R on the audio thread:
   ρ = mean(LR) / (sqrt(mean(L²)·mean(R²)) + ε), ρ ∈ [-1, 1].
   One-pole running means with time constant ≈ 300 ms (coeff from sampleRate); ε silence guard. Publish smoothed ρ as std::atomic<float> (memory_order relaxed or acquire/release as appropriate).
3. Goniometer transport: juce::AbstractFifo lock-free SPSC sized ~4096 stereo frames; push decimated L/R pairs (e.g. every Nth sample so UI @ 30–60 Hz is fed). No lock, no heap allocation, no juce::String on the push path.
4. prepare allocates any ring storage once; process/push never resizes.
5. RT-safe; O(1) per pushed sample.

Do not implement ShredWidthEngine, PluginProcessor wiring, tests, or CMakeLists.
acceptance_criteria: MeterTap publishes smoothed Pearson correlation via std::atomic<float>
Correlation uses one-pole means with ~300 ms time constant and an epsilon guard
MeterTap pushes decimated L/R pairs through juce::AbstractFifo (~4096 frames capacity)
prepare/reset/push (and UI drain) API present; no allocation, lock, or juce::String on the audio push path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify ShredWidthEngine, PluginProcessor, PluginEditor, ParameterIDs, StateManager
modify other Source/DSP/** primitives (PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor)
use mutex/CriticalSection or allocate on the push path

allowed: choose decimation stride N for FIFO push
expose either pushSample and/or block push plus a simple UI drain API
store L/R pairs as interleaved floats or struct of two floats
forbidden: cross threads with locks or message-thread calls from push
